newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasury seizes $29 million of illicit funds.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasury seizes $29 million of illicit funds.

text.p: The Treasury Department announced on Monday that federal authorities investigating a money laundering scheme have seized $29 million in drug money that was headed for Colombia.
The money was seized since August under an order initiated by the Treasury Department against agents sending money to Colombia from the New York area.
The order requires about 3,500 businesses that receive money and send it to designated recipients to submit to strict reporting and record keeping.
The companies must report to the government identifying information about the parties to all transmissions of money to Colombia exceeding $750.
Raymond Kelly, Treasury's undersecretary for enforcement, said that last year more than $1.5 billion was sent to Colombia by New York area money transmitters.
